title: Using load shedding to avoid overload
author: David Yanacek, Amazon Builders' Library
why: How Amazon measures goodput, load-tests past capacity and sheds cheaply, including dropping work whose client has already given up.

title: Site Reliability Engineering, chapter 21: Handling Overload
author: Google (Beyer, Jones, Petoff, Murphy, eds.)
why: The source of the criticality levels and the client-side adaptive throttling formula; read with the next chapter on cascading failures.

title: Resilience4j Bulkhead documentation
author: Resilience4j
why: Concrete configuration of semaphore and thread-pool bulkheads, showing exactly which knobs exist and what each one limits.

title: Netflix concurrency-limits
author: Netflix
why: A real implementation of adaptive concurrency limits based on TCP congestion-control ideas, with server and client integrations.
